settings.text: The desiccant filling machine for double-glazed glass spacers is an essential part of a standard insulating glass production line. It helps reduce labor requirements, improve process quality and accuracy, and save considerable production time.

settings.title: Why Is a Desiccant Filling Machine Essential for Double-Glazed Glass?
settings.text:
Condensation between the panes of a double-glazed window after installation indicates poor manufacturing quality and is one of the most troublesome issues encountered during window installation.
The main cause is an insufficient amount of desiccant (silica gel) inside the aluminum spacer between the two panes.
Other causes include the absence of rainwater drainage slots or an improperly designed glass unit.
To prevent condensation in insulating glass production, the inside of the aluminum spacer is filled with desiccant.
This process is carried out by a silica gel filling machine, also known as a desiccant filling machine, before the butyl application stage.
If the silica gel is stored properly, away from exposure to ambient air and moisture, and a sufficient quantity is injected along the entire length of the spacer, the risk of condensation between the panes can be reduced to almost zero.
A silica gel filling machine ensures that the desiccant is distributed evenly and at the proper density throughout the spacer, minimizing condensation problems.
This high level of performance leads many insulating glass manufacturers to purchase silica gel filling machines to improve customer satisfaction and increase sales.

settings.title: How Does the Desiccant Filling Machine Work?
settings.text:
The machine operates as follows: the operator first places the bent spacer inside the desiccant filling machine.
After the Start button is pressed, the machine begins operating. Two drills simultaneously make holes in two sides of the spacer, and silica gel is then injected into it.
The filling process is completed automatically. Sensors that detect the amount of desiccant inside the spacer send a signal to the machine controller, and the PLC immediately issues a command to stop the injection.
The machine then automatically fills the drilled holes with butyl to prevent the silica gel desiccant from leaking out of the spacer.

settings.title: Technical Specifications and Features of the Silica Gel Filling Machine
settings.text:
The machine can fill spacers ranging from 250 mm to 2,000 mm in length.
The silica gel filling machine usually features an adjustable-height head. When filling long spacers, a pneumatic cylinder moves the machine head vertically to facilitate the filling process.
Spacer width can range from 6 to 32 mm.
The desiccant hopper must be equipped with a heating element to prevent the silica gel from absorbing moisture from the surrounding air.
The machine's control system should also heat the hopper periodically using a timer and maintain a specific temperature to help prevent moisture from reaching the silica gel.
In automatic silica gel filling machines, a vibrator can be used to inject a larger quantity of desiccant into the spacer.
This useful option is also available on some semi-automatic silica gel filling machines.
We recommend choosing a silica gel filling machine with this feature. Over time, the moisture absorption capacity of silica gel may decrease; filling the spacer at a higher density helps maintain the quality of the double-glazed glass.
Other features and technical specifications include:
Higher production capacity by filling more than 20 spacers simultaneously
Single-phase operation with low power consumption
Equipped with a 25 kg hopper
High-quality, standard components
Electrostatic powder coating with oven curing
Three-star Gold Warranty for 18 months
After-sales service and spare parts supply for 360 months

settings.title: Factors Affecting the Price of Desiccant Filling Machines
settings.text:
The price of a machine for filling aluminum spacers used in double-glazed glass depends on the quality of its equipment and components, motors, pneumatic valves, and sensors.
Because of its precision and importance, desiccant filling in aluminum spacers must be carried out with a high degree of accuracy.
Lubricating the machine's rails and guides is also important, as desiccant powder settling on these components can gradually cause wear.
